references.label: Single drop target
references.description: Upper-left drop target that enables the lit-star multiplier advance.

references.label: Lit star lane
references.description: Upper-left star switch used after the single drop target to advance Bonus X.

references.label: Three-target battery
references.description: Upper-right target bank that provides the alternate Bonus X route.

references.label: Four left targets
references.description: Left-side targets whose repeat hits alternate Extra Ball and Special after completion.

references.label: Three right targets
references.description: Right-side targets that qualify the captive-ball award track.

references.label: Captive ball
references.description: Upper-right captive ball that advances its lamps toward Extra Ball.

references.label: Eject hole
references.description: Upper-right hole that collects its lit points, Extra Ball, or Prepare Special award.
